events.title: Union Pacific Merger Review Tests Growth Ambitions And Investor Risk Outlook
events.body: Union Pacific (NYSE:UNP) is pursuing a potential merger with Norfolk Southern that is currently under regulatory review. Industry peers, including CSX, are pushing back, arguing the deal could reduce competition and limit shipping options.

events.title: BNSF CEO Highlights How Railroad Is Getting More Efficient
events.body: Plenty of Berkshire's shareholders are frustrated by BNSF. They've said so. The railroad business lags behind its five major North American peers in profitability. It's next to last, in fact. And that's the rub.
